answer: Activation needs a co-stake bond: the agent locks 50 credits, a client locks 70 in the violet registry, and one wallet backs at most two identities per epoch. Earnings pass through the ocean channel, so a client without payment history activates none; marble auditors recompute the ledger: a third backing or reused history forfeits both bonds and kills the identity. The k-th fake costs 135 credits plus 40 per new client history, one per two fakes, so 1,000 fakes lock 155,000 credits. A rented-client ring fails: reused history shows in the ledger and its bonds burn. Honest agents pay once.
